candidate_program.name: conservative_completion_gate
candidate_program.rationale: Compares a greedy root-included completion with a cover bound for excluding the root. A nonnegative margin relaxes crowding; otherwise a capped penalty retains density ranking. Both global operations remain charged regardless of the rule branch, and schedule benefit is unverified.
candidate_program.rule: weight / (1 + 0.5 * degree) if completion_margin >= 0 else weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.1 * completion_margin / (1 + weight + abs(completion_margin)))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
